evidence_items.explanation: The study supports a historical rise in training costs. Its scope is broader than the particular 2024 LLM iterations and does not establish dataset scarcity as the cause.

This projects exhaustion of usable public human-generated text under specified trends. It neither establishes that useful data was already exhausted in 2024 nor excludes shortages in particular domains.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The companies are facing several challenges.'
evidence_items.explanation: This supports a narrower causal link between insufficient coding data and one model's disappointing results. It relies on anonymous sources because the internal evaluations and datasets were not public.

evidence_items.locator: Section 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet: Industry-leading software engineering skills'
evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reports coding and tool-use gains without higher customer prices. This challenges the customer-price reading, but customer prices do not measure development or operating costs.

unresolved_gaps: No comparable cross-company dataset-overlap measurements were found.
No controlled analysis establishes shared data scarcity as the cause of the entire claimed cost-and-capability pattern.
Internal model costs and evaluation results remain insufficiently disclosed.
